prompt_text: Who is the best HVAC company in Houston for AC repair?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” HVAC company for everyone — the right choice depends on your Houston neighborhood, budget, how fast you need service, whether you want a major company or a local tech, and whether you need a repair or a system replacement. That said, here’s a short, practical way to find the best option for you plus a few widely recommended names to consider.

How to pick the best HVAC company in Houston
- Check reviews and ratings: Google Reviews, Yelp, Angi/HomeAdvisor, and the BBB. Look for recent reviews about the same kind of repair you need.  
- Verify credentials: Texas HVAC license (TACLA number), proof of insurance, and NATE certification for technicians if possible.  
- Ask about warranties: parts, labor, and any satisfaction guarantees.  
- Get a written estimate: include diagnostics fee, parts, labor, and any potential additional charges.  
- Ask specific questions: ETA for service, flat-rate pricing vs. hourly, emergency service availability, and whether they’ll recommend repair vs. replacement.  
- Compare 2–3 bids before deciding (unless it’s an emergency).  
- Prefer companies that offer preventive maintenance plans if you want long-term reliability.

Companies commonly recommended in Houston (starting points)
- John Moore Services — Houston-based, large footprint, offers emergency service and maintenance plans.  
- ARS / Rescue Rooter — national company with local teams, often available for same-day service.  
- One Hour Heating & Air / On Time Heating & Air (local franchises) — known for timed arrivals and nationwide franchise support.

Typical costs & what to expect
- Diagnostic fee: $75–$150 (often applied to repair cost if you hire them)  
- Common repairs: capacitor $150–$400; contactor $100–$300; refrigerant leak repair + recharge varies widely ($200–$800+) depending on the problem; compressor replacement or major repairs can run $1,000–3,500+  
- Full system replacement: often $4,000–$12,000 depending on system size and brand

What I can do next
- If you share your zip code or neighborhood and whether you want fastest, cheapest, or highest-rated service, I can suggest nearby companies and a prioritized list to contact.  
- If you already have a quote, paste it and I can help evaluate it.

Want me to look up top-rated options in your specific area? If so, tell me your zip code.
